residencia fiscal.note: Not immigration status or a visa clock. DIAN looks at art. 10; Migración looks at stay.

periodo gravable.note: Colombian calendar-year default unless the statute says otherwise.

renta.note: Keep 'renta' in a gloss on first use in a title. Not 'rent'.

ganancia ocasional.note: A Colombian schedule, not UK CGT. Do not render as capital gains tax.

impuesto sobre la renta.note: The Colombian income tax on residents and, with limits, nonresidents.

retención en la fuente.note: Keep the Colombian mechanism visible; it is not U.S. backup withholding.

contribuyente.note: Natural or juridical person as the statute defines.

responsable.note: Not always the taxpayer. VAT and withholding have 'responsables'.

persona natural.note: Prefer 'individual' over 'natural person' in running text; keep the Spanish on first mention.

persona jurídica.note: Do not default to 'corporation'; Colombian entities are broader than U.S. C-corps.

establecimiento permanente.note: OECD term. Keep it. Do not invent a U.S. 'office or fixed place' paraphrase as the rule.

declaración.note: The filing, not a court declaration.

sanción.note: Administrative unless the provision is criminal.

GMF.note: Keep the acronym. It is not a stamp duty.
